learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basic principle of radar and electromagnetic sensing
Describe the radar range equation and detection concepts qualitatively
Compare sensor modalities such as radar, lidar, infrared and optical
Describe sensor system components and signal processing at a concept level
Explain sensor fusion and its benefits conceptually
Communicate sensing system trade-offs to non-specialists

integrative_case: A sensing class evaluates, at concept level only, a sensor suite for an environmental monitoring platform: they explain the radar principle and detection trade-offs, compare radar, lidar, infrared and optical options, and outline signal processing and fusion, presenting trade-offs for a design review.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
